notes:
## What's new

**Launch mode**
- Terminal text size controls: A− / A+ icons to the left of the full-screen button grow or shrink each terminal's text (per-terminal, persisted, 8–30px).
- Direct CLI agent terminals no longer claim the Launch agent's AI model in the header — the model is shown only when actually known, otherwise omitted.

**Connect**
- Resend is now a built-in featured MCP connector alongside GitHub, Stripe, Vercel, and Supabase (hosted endpoint, Resend API key).

**Engine fixes (from the 2026-09-10 session)**
- Auto-merge now covers every finished sub-agent with a worktree on disk, even if it dropped out of the pending list — uncommitted worktree work can no longer be silently lost.
- The sub-agent finished signal is delivered as a hidden follow-up, never as a user-visible queued message.
- The orchestrator now replies to check_subagent / list_subagents / view_subagent_conversation results before parking on its sub-agents (no more silent turn ends).
- The background-task stall watcher no longer kills healthy-but-silent commands (e.g. builds piped through tail) — it checks the child's CPU time before killing, and the stalled status is now reported accurately.
- Sub-agents running over 20 minutes get one engine-sent time-box nudge to converge and wrap up.

**Also**
- Restored the Launch terminal fit() sane-size guard (mid-animation fits no longer reflow the PTY to a few columns).

Built with ChatOSS.ai
